entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), Section III.2 (Safety and Security)
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V 'On Personal Data and Their Protection' (21 May 2013)
entries.provision: Article 12, Paragraph 1 (requirement for accuracy and reliability of personal data)
entries.why_here: Blocks out-of-range GPA or exam inputs before model inference so malformed records cannot generate arbitrary scores.

entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), Section III.2 (Fairness and Non-Discrimination)
entries.instrument: Constitution of the Republic of Kazakhstan (30 August 1995)
entries.provision: Article 14, Paragraph 2 (prohibition of discrimination based on origin, social status, gender, or language)
entries.why_here: Removes name and university fields to eliminate the +2.5 score advantage for flagship universities (sign p=0.002) and name-related flips.

entries.principle: Respect for Human Rights, Consent, and Purpose Limitation
entries.principle_source: OECD Recommendation of the Council on Artificial Intelligence (OECD/LEGAL/0449, 2019, amended 2024), Principle 1.2
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V 'On Personal Data and Their Protection' (21 May 2013)
entries.provision: Article 7, Paragraph 1 and Article 8 (collection and processing strictly within declared purposes and with subject consent)
entries.why_here: Stops unauthorized purposes, minors under 18, unconsented profiles, and prompt-injection strings before calling the model.

entries.principle_source: OECD Recommendation of the Council on Artificial Intelligence (OECD/LEGAL/0449, 2019, amended 2024), Principles 1.3 and 1.5
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 418-V 'On Informatization' (24 November 2015)
entries.provision: Article 36, Paragraph 1 (ensuring integrity, auditability, and logging of electronic information resources)
entries.why_here: Writes a SHA-256 input hash, field lists, raw reply, and fired controls to decisions.jsonl so auditors can reconstruct every decision without storing PII.

entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021), Section III.2 (Human Oversight and Determination)
entries.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU Artificial Intelligence Act, 13 June 2024) — cited as an international benchmark for educational AI
entries.provision: Article 14, Paragraphs 1–2 (human oversight to prevent or minimize risks to rights and livelihood)
entries.why_here: Routes borderline scores (40-49), unparseable outputs, and rejected lowest-income applicants to human reviewers, escalating 46 of 400 profiles (11.5%).
